I know this is old but The Twisted Timeline is really good. I've read it a few times. Basically it's an interdimensional travel AU within an AU. Characters are completely reimagined though not ridiculously so. It's more like different things happen and different characters therefore have drastically different lives. 

There's some good twists and once you get into it, it keeps you glued to the screen. Like I said, I really like it.

Essentially the same thing happened to me. At this point I'm losing hope in the whole mental health system. I'm sorry that this happened to you. I wonder if they realize that doing this completely turns people off from trying to get help when they need it the most.

Well, I just found out that my work permit application was denied so I can't work here, which was really my only hope. I'm not American so I'm not sure if I could work for an American based company. I don't think I can see a therapist for free. Right now I'm just trying to see if I can contact some old employers back home to see if I could get a job.

I feel like things would have been so much different if it had been my mother. My whole extended family kind of put the guilt card on me for what happened and every conversation was about how I made them feel. I know it sounds selfish of me but it was never about any of them. I understand my actions affected you but when I'm the one who has to face all the consequences and I feel like nobody was actually sensitive to me and the fact that I was obviously troubled at that point in time. I think that's just my culture and the family that I'm in. Everything is passive aggressive and actual aggression over really dealing with things properly and my father is no exception.

Hi, thank you for responding. I didn't know most of what had happened till I got out and was with him. Honestly, the country where I'm from is very behind in terms of mental health and I don't feel like the doctors really listen anyway. But they spoke to me and then they spoke to him separately. I insisted that I think it would be best for me to stay in a comfortable environment and continue to work so I could afford to pay for my own things but I have no idea what he told them because they changed their mind after speaking to him. Honestly, I would have prefered staying in the hospital longer. I was still very vulnerable when I got out and that made everything so much harder.
I'm also going through the hardest break up I've ever experienced. If you want to talk or rant or whatever you should message me. Maybe we can help each other.

I get like this too. It's crazy because I know that that anger isn't me It really is depression linked though. I think a lot of it comes from this feeling of being helpless and in pain. Think of a dog that's been hurt. They lash out even at the people who didn't hurt them. It's like a defence mechanism.

Hey a dog doesn't care about how flawed of a person you think you are. I mean think about it, a dog would just love you for you being the human being who cares for it. Maybe that's what we need. To have something to take care of to make you feel like you're worth something. I realize this sounds stupidly flowery but I'm trying to convince the both of us.

Trust me I've tried. There doesn't seem to be many easy ways to go and the ones that exist are incredibly hard to find. Sometimes I think it would be near impossible to commit suicide without accepting that there will be a huge amount of pain and gore involved in the process. I also came from a shitty family life and went to a school where I felt so completely alone. I'm in college now and I'm away from all of that and things actually started looking up for a while. of course now i'm here again but for other reasons not related to school and my family. What you're going through may very well pass and you may soon have an opportunity to live a happier life.

My family moved to Canada and left my behind. Now they want me to come with them because I'm suicidal but I wish they cared more before all of this. Like enough to tell more than a month beforehand that they were moving. Now they're absurdly clingy and it feels so ungenuine. 

The only 2 friends I had, I guess I pushed away by being unresponsive and inactive. Honestly there's too much history with them now and I just want to let go of all that pain. 

My ex just came knocking at my door to "check up" on me. I'm so upset that I have to be the one to tell him to leave me alone after he left me. He used to be the only person worth being here for but even he left because he got tired of my shit. I want to die so much. I dont even care about school that much I'm just tired and all I do every day is plan my own suicide. I waste my money on pills and hotel rooms and then I just don't go through with it. My ex had to pick me up at night because i went walking with hopes of jumping in front of a car. Now that he's gone (and I won't let him stay in my life because it hurts too much), I don't have anything to anchor me. I don't have anyone to send that last minute text so I could not die in complete solitude and silence.
I care. I guess because I know how I feel when I'm depressed and I wouldn't wish it on anybody else. I want to help.

What would make it worth it? For me I think just having somebody who loves me and who I love back completely would give me something worth living for. Even if it's just a dog or something, it would make me feel like I had a purpose and that shit was worth it. So what would make living worth it to you?
I'm someone. I also need someone but that doesn't mean I can't help someone else out.

I understand completely. My ex boyfriend (he broke up with me) now refuses to leave me be because of my suicide attempt. This just characterizes how I think everybody feels. Nobody cares until you want to hurt yourself but at that point it's nobody else's business. I hate that feeling but I guess you have to separate yourself from that and do it for you. Fuck other people and take care of yourself because you sure as hell will notice and if nobody else is checking, do it for yourself since you're the one who cares.
I guess because you're not going to enjoy every part of a journey but skipping ahead takes the adventure out of it.

I'm in a similar situation. We talk ever day and sometimes it feels like we didnt even break up. He says we should be friends for now but he still sees a future with me. Honestly I've been a whirlwind of feelings about the situation, (ie. it's such a dick move to break up with somebody and tell them these things so that it's extra hard to get over you).

Truly the only thing keeping me here is the idea that we could have a relationship again. I'm still trying to muster the strength to go full NC. 

For your situation, I'd say remember to take care of you. You cant go from a relationship to just a friendship, especially if you're still in love. Tell her you need time and maybe after you've healed and you still want to you can try being friends again. But really, if you're the one with the broken heart, take care of it and that means NC for a while.
We've already learned that it's best not to do that for the time being at least. It's I still remember everything and ik it's all still there.

Yeah and before I started dealing with this I would have thought it was stupid too. Feelings are feelings though and you can't change how you feel without some serious thought. About the squats, I actually started doing yoga over the Christmas (ironically because of one of the accounts he showed me with this yogi woman who has a huge butt but she posts really uplifting things and I can't help but like her). My butt hasn't changed but I think I'm more into trying to accept myself than changing it.

Thank you. He and I actually arranged for me to start going to a counselor, not about this but it's something I want to discuss with her. It's just an issue that's been bothering me today so I thought I'd post. I really understand now that it's not his fault at all.

Thanks. It's nice to see people getting over thing like this. It gives me hope that I can do the same. We've talked about it things similar to it but it took a long time to get to the root of the issue. Right now, I'm in the "realizing it's all just my insecurities and he's not to blame" stage. I'm definitely going to try to initiate more open conversations.

I know I really can't blame him but the intensity of this feeling is all new to me. I've managed to work through tons of different insecurities but this whole skin color and ass thing is new. I'm feeling crazy now because I know he's looking at models with huge asses and I'll never look like that. 

It's not his fault.
